formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x2 : List (Fin (11 : ℕ))),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 →     x2.length ≤ (2 : ℕ) →       (∀ (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool),           have x6 : List Bool := List.ofFn x5 ++ [x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ))];           x1.eval (x6 ++ [PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and.eval (List.map (fun (x7 : Fin (11 : ℕ)) => x6.getD (↑x7) Bool.false) x2)]) = (x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))) →         (14 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size
plain_statement: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). Add two wires to the inputs: AND(x_0, x_3), and one AND gate reading any at most two of the wires so far. Every circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates on the eleven wires that computes the function has at least 14 gates.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate AND(x_0, x_3) computes its edge function
